title: Gears 5
summary: Native HDR tone-map replacement with PsychoV35, PrismTM, RenoDRT and extended SDR Vanilla+, plus UI brightness limited to 203 nits.
notes: Native HDR mode is required for the custom tone-mapping path.

Four scene-LUT variants, the tactical-view composite, the red damage HUD and the final HDR/UI composite are registered in both compute and pixel forms for Async Compute on/off; additional permutations remain unverified.
Use an unprotected single-player session for development.
